entries.title: Ephesians 6:1
segments: ¶Children, obey your parents in the Lord, for this is right.

entries.title: Ephesians 6:2
segments: "Honor your father and mother," which is the first commandment with promise:

entries.title: Ephesians 6:3
segments: "that it may be well with you and you may live long on the earth."

entries.title: Ephesians 6:4
segments: And you, fathers, do not provoke your children to wrath, but bring them up in the training and admonition of the Lord.

entries.title: Ephesians 6:5
segments: Bondservants, be obedient to those who are your masters according to the flesh, with fear and trembling, in sincerity of heart, as to Christ;

entries.title: Ephesians 6:6
segments: not with eyeservice, as men-pleasers, but as bondservants of Christ, doing the will of God from the heart,

entries.title: Ephesians 6:7
segments: with goodwill doing service, as to the Lord, and not to men,

entries.title: Ephesians 6:8
segments: knowing that whatever good anyone does, he will receive the same from the Lord, whether [he is] a slave or free.

entries.title: Ephesians 6:9
segments: And you, masters, do the same things to them, giving up threatening, knowing that your own Master also is in heaven, and there is no partiality with Him.

entries.title: Ephesians 6:10
segments: ¶Finally, my brethren, be strong in the Lord and in the power of His might.

entries.title: Ephesians 6:11
segments: Put on the whole armor of God, that you may be able to stand against the wiles of the devil.

entries.title: Ephesians 6:12
segments: For we do not wrestle against flesh and blood, but against principalities, against powers, against the rulers of the darkness of this age, against spiritual [hosts] of wickedness in the heavenly [places].

entries.title: Ephesians 6:13
segments: Therefore take up the whole armor of God, that you may be able to withstand in the evil day, and having done all, to stand.

entries.title: Ephesians 6:14
segments: Stand therefore, having girded your waist with truth, having put on the breastplate of righteousness,

entries.title: Ephesians 6:15
segments: and having shod your feet with the preparation of the gospel of peace;

entries.title: Ephesians 6:16
segments: above all, taking the shield of faith with which you will be able to quench all the fiery darts of the wicked one.

entries.title: Ephesians 6:17
segments: And take the helmet of salvation, and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God;

entries.title: Ephesians 6:18
segments: praying always with all prayer and supplication in the Spirit, being watchful to this end with all perseverance and supplication for all the saints--

entries.title: Ephesians 6:19
segments: ¶and for me, that utterance may be given to me, that I may open my mouth boldly to make known the mystery of the gospel,

entries.title: Ephesians 6:20
segments: for which I am an ambassador in chains; that in it I may speak boldly, as I ought to speak.

entries.title: Ephesians 6:21
segments: But that you also may know my affairs [and] how I am doing, Tychicus, a beloved brother and faithful minister in the Lord, will make all things known to you;

entries.title: Ephesians 6:22
segments: whom I have sent to you for this very purpose, that you may know our affairs, and [that] he may comfort your hearts.

entries.title: Ephesians 6:23
segments: Peace to the brethren, and love with faith, from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

entries.title: Ephesians 6:24
segments: Grace [be] with all those who love our Lord Jesus Christ in sincerity. Amen.
